fontFamily._note: Neither font ships with Fuselage or is currently loaded anywhere in the fork. Must be self-hosted (woff2) under apps/meteor/public/fonts/ and @font-face'd in eprisi-tokens.css — no external font CDN calls (CSP / offline-deployment constraints for this fork). Font files need to be sourced and added in GATE 2.

darkMode_note: Neither login.jpg nor dashboard.jpg has a dark-mode variant. Per GATE 1 rules, darkMode is left null — dark mode will continue to inherit Fuselage's existing dark palette untouched. Note the dashboard sidebar/navbar in the LIGHT mockup already use near-black tones (#0F1728 / #0A2535), which happens to be close to Fuselage's current forced-dark sidebar behavior in MainLayoutStyleTags.tsx — this is likely coincidental, not evidence of an intentional dark-mode design.
